system.name: SEED-Bench
system.one_liner: A benchmark for multimodal LLMs that sorts capabilities into levels L0 to L4 by input and output modalities and evaluates 27 dimensions up to L3.

content.variant_note: two taxonomies side by side: an isometric pyramid of capability levels carrying models, benchmarks and input-output bands, and a four-ring sunburst of the 27 evaluation dimensions
content.argues: SEED-Bench covers a hierarchy of MLLM capability levels up to L3 through 27 dimensions in three cumulative parts, where each higher level includes the lower tiers.
content.subject: Pyramid of task levels L0 to L4 with models and benchmarks, and a sunburst of the 27 evaluation dimensions in three parts

content.reading_order: The eye lands on the large pyramid and climbs from the green L0 base to the grey padlocked L4 tip along the axis arrow, reading models, benchmarks and chevron bands per tier; it then moves right to the sunburst, from the centre arcs outward to the 27 leaf dimensions.

layout.arrangement_note: Two unframed drawings side by side, separated by whitespace. At the left an isometric five-tier pyramid (L0 at the bottom, L4 at the top) tilted so that its left face carries model names and its right face benchmark names, a diagonal axis arrow along its left edge and a chevron band extending right from each tier; at the right a four-ring sunburst with a spiral-arrow centre.

encoding.color_means: tier colour climbs from mint green (L0) through cyan, blue and indigo to grey (L4, padlocked); in the sunburst blue = Part 1, green = Part 2, brown or tan = Part 3, kept on the group and leaf rings and echoed by the centre arcs for L1, L2, L3
encoding.line_style_means: grey diagonal arrow = rising task level; white gaps = boundaries between sunburst sectors; thin spiral arrows at the centre = levels that accumulate
encoding.shape_means: isometric tier = a capability level with model names on the left face and benchmark names on the right face; chevron band = input and output modality of the level; ring sector = part, group or dimension; padlock = L4 not covered
encoding.marker_means: L0 to L4 name the tiers; Part 1 to Part 3 name the benchmark parts; the padlock marks the top tier as locked
encoding.emphasis: A greyed, padlocked L4 against coloured L0 to L3 shows where SEED-Bench stops; the centre arcs show L3 containing L2 containing L1; the size of the Part 1 sector shows where most dimensions sit.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a benchmark's scope twice: a tilted pyramid of capability levels whose faces carry the models and benchmarks of each level and whose side bands give the input and output modalities, and a sunburst that breaks the covered levels into parts, groups and leaf dimensions in one hue per part.
lessons.suits: Benchmark or capability-taxonomy papers that need levels, who sits at each level and a fine-grained list of dimensions in one composite.

summary: SEED-Bench is a benchmark for multimodal LLMs that sorts their capabilities into hierarchical levels L0 to L4 by the modalities they accept and generate, and evaluates 27 dimensions up to L3. Figure 1 has two parts. At the left, a tilted five-tier pyramid, coloured from mint green (L0) to grey (L4, with a padlock), puts example models on its left face and benchmarks on its right face, with a chevron band per tier that states the input and output modality using person and robot icons. At the right, a four-ring sunburst fans three benchmark parts out into six groups and 27 dimensions, with arcs labelled L1, L2 and L3 at the centre showing that the levels accumulate.
summary_zh: SEED-Bench 按输入输出模态把多模态大模型能力分成 L0 到 L4 的层级，并评测到 L3 的 27 个维度。左图是斜置的五层金字塔，两侧列出各层的模型和基准，条带标明输入输出；右图是旭日图，把三个部分展开为 27 个评测维度。

The padlock and the grey tint on L4 are read as 'beyond coverage' because the caption says coverage stops at L3; the figure itself does not explain them.
